K-means groups points around $K$ cluster centers, called **centroids**. Explore
Lloyd's algorithm on the same three-blob data used in the notebook, with $K=3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Each iteration alternates between two steps: **assign** every point to its nearest
centroid, then **update** each centroid to the mean of its assigned points. The
colored points show the current assignments; the large crosses show the centroids.
After an update, arrows show where the centroids moved.
:::

The initial centroids match the seeded random initialization in last year's
[clustering notebook](https://github.com/changyaochen/MECE4520/blob/fall_2025/lectures/notebooks/18_clustering.ipynb).
The accompanying notebook uses multiple k-means++ initializations, so its steps
and result may differ. The synthetic labels are not used by the algorithm.
